article.title: Proof of document not required by law to be attested
article.content: An attested document not required by law to be attested may be proved as if it was unattested.
article.html:
71Proof of document not required by law to be attested

Section 71 · Part III · Chapter V

An attested document not required by law to be attested may be proved as if it was unattested.
